description: Full control-character taxonomy in one string value. Covers all three escape categories from RFC 8785 §3.2.2.2: (1) unnamed control characters serialized as lowercase \uXXXX: NUL (U+0000 -> \u0000), SOH (U+0001 -> \u0001), BEL (U+0007 -> \u0007), ESC (U+001B -> \u001b), US (U+001F -> \u001f); (2) named two-character escapes: BS (U+0008 -> \b), TAB (U+0009 -> \t), LF (U+000A -> \n), FF (U+000C -> \f), CR (U+000D -> \r). All \uXXXX sequences use LOWERCASE hex. No code point above U+001F is escaped.
note: This vector pins the full set at once so a partial-implementation defect (e.g., correct for \t but wrong for \u001b) cannot hide behind coverage of only the named-escape subset.
